name: SSH Hardening
description: Installs an authorized public key, disables password authentication, restricts root login, and optionally changes the SSH port. Validates the config with `sshd -t` before reloading so you can't lock yourself out.

params.name: publicKey
params.label: Authorized public key
params.help: OpenSSH public key to append to the target user's authorized_keys (e.g. 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA...'). Leave blank to skip.

params.name: sshPort
params.label: SSH port (optional)
params.help: Change the SSH listening port. Leave blank to keep the current port.
